usage: speechloom doctor [-h] [--ffmpeg FFMPEG] [--ffprobe FFPROBE]
                         [--nemo-speech NEMO_SPEECH] [--model MODEL]
                         [--diar-model DIAR_MODEL]
                         [--translation-model TRANSLATION_MODEL]
                         [--source-language SOURCE_LANGUAGE]
                         [--translate-to TRANSLATE_TO] [--device DEVICE]
                         [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ffmpeg FFMPEG
  --ffprobe FFPROBE
  --nemo-speech NEMO_SPEECH
  --model MODEL
  --diar-model DIAR_MODEL
  --translation-model TRANSLATION_MODEL
  --source-language SOURCE_LANGUAGE
                        Spoken language, for example ru
  --translate-to TRANSLATE_TO
                        Translate transcript outputs, for example en
  --device DEVICE       auto, cpu, cuda[:N], metal, vulkan[:N], or gpu[:N]
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --json                Emit machine-readable diagnostics
